Title: Caramelized and Sticky Pork Neck
Servings: 4

Ingredients (component | amount unit | name | prep_style | pantry food_id):
- Caramelized Pork | 1500 g | pork bone-in neck steaks |  | 000036
- Caramelized Pork | 100 g | brown sugar |  | 000360
- Caramelized Pork | 1 tbsp | Water |  | IMP-b38735
- Caramelized Pork | 2 pcs | shallots |  | 000113
- Caramelized Pork | 2 cloves | garlic |  | 000112
- Caramelized Pork | 1 tbsp | ground ginger |  | 000282
- Caramelized Pork | 400 ml | coconut milk |  | 000191
- Caramelized Pork | 0.5 tsp | ground white pepper |  | 000286
- Caramelized Pork | 1.5 tbsp | fish sauce |  | 000487
- Side and Garnish | 400 g | white rice |  | 000309
- Side and Garnish | 3 stalks | spring onions |  | 000116
- Side and Garnish | 10 g | cilantro |  | 000245
- Side and Garnish | 1 pcs | chili peppers |  | 000097
- Side and Garnish | 1 pcs | lime |  | 000131

Steps in order (component | phase | minutes | text):
1. Caramelized Pork | Prep | 15 | Remove the bones from the pork neck steaks and rinse the meat thoroughly to remove any bone fragments. Finely chop the shallots, garlic, and ginger.
2. Caramelized Pork | Cook | 5 | In a large pot, melt the brown sugar with 1 tablespoon of water over medium-high heat until it turns into a dark caramel.
3. Caramelized Pork | Cook | 2 | Add the chopped shallots, garlic, and ginger to the caramel and stir to combine.
4. Caramelized Pork | Cook | 2 | Add the pork pieces to the pot. Handle raw meat with care and wash hands after contact.
5. Caramelized Pork | Cook | 5 | Pour in the coconut milk and add the white pepper and fish sauce. Bring the mixture to a boil on high heat.
6. Caramelized Pork | Cook | 120 | Reduce the heat to medium and let the pot simmer uncovered for 1.5 to 2 hours. Stir occasionally until the liquid evaporates and the sugar begins to caramelize around the meat.
7. Side and Garnish | Cook | 20 | While the pork is simmering, cook the jasmine rice according to package instructions.
8. Caramelized Pork | Cook | 30 | Once the liquid is reduced and the meat is tender enough to fall apart, continue to cook and brown the meat in its own rendered fat for another 20-30 minutes, stirring to prevent burning.
9. Side and Garnish | Prep | 5 | Finely slice the spring onions and chili peppers. Roughly chop the cilantro.
10. Side and Garnish | Serve | 2 | Serve the sticky caramelized pork over a bed of jasmine rice. Garnish with spring onions, cilantro, and chili. Squeeze fresh lime juice over the top before eating.
